title: Classroom Decision Simulator
description: Interactive branching simulator with 4 real classroom scenarios — disengagement, pacing crises, challenge questions, authority tests — each choice revealing research-informed feedback from Marzano, Wong & Wong, and Emmer & Evertson.
data_vintage: Practitioner research: Marzano 2003, Wong & Wong 2009, Emmer & Evertson 2013
